design_doctrine.play_interface: Three runtime-switchable control modes: Party (player controls full playable roster), Focus (player controls exactly one selectable actor while AI operates all others), Spectator (AI controls all and player watches/pauses/steps); character camera/viewpoint independent. Natural-language intention and method; Evolved dice/skills remain hidden.
design_doctrine.capabilities: Four Evolved attributes, twelve Evolved skill categories, career-linked starting skill emphasis and talent choices; no exclusively class-locked skill. Adapt careers and talents to Jurassic Park while preserving underlying math/procedures.
design_doctrine.ai_role: Translate player's described methods to vetted Evolved skill/attribute pairing, allowed talent triggers, meaningful stakes, timed sequence and legal environmental effects; never roll or edit state.
design_doctrine.engine_role: Perform seeded base and stress d6 rolls, apply exact Evolved skill/push/Resolve/stress/panic/stunt/health/action-economy logic, validate physical reality, inventory, characters and hidden dinosaur state, persist events and results.
design_doctrine.checks: Only uncertain actions with meaningful stakes; handle routine and impossible actions without RNG, and composite action sequences with transparent time/action costs
design_doctrine.probability: REPLACED: Preserve actual Evolved dice procedures under the screen. May compute numeric success probabilities for QA/debug without changing the original distribution; arbitrary percent-based probability engine postponed until after faithful Evolved parity and only by approval.
design_doctrine.current_implementation: As of 007-L1: Character Lab creates and launches manually/automatically/hybrid-built 1–8 survivor parties; Party/Character/Spectator modes and independent camera run in the 007-series game with knowledge-bounded deterministic offline companions. Legacy 006.2 remains separate; full generative GM, world-dependent talents and Evolved parity remain incomplete.
design_doctrine.character_creation: Player can manually create, automatically generate, or mix both per party member, including whole party/partial generation, selective rerolls and locks, Evolved rule validation and separate seeded generator. Valid before incident; character progression afterward only via rules.

mechanics_direction: Faithful Alien RPG Evolved Edition mechanics first; actual seeded hidden d6 pools, stress dice, Resolve, 12 skills, career-linked talents, pushes, stunts, stealth/combat/actions, injury and gear, adapted with original Jurassic Park content. Differences only via explicit approved house rules.

raptor_encounter_implementation.rules_source: Alien Evolved stealth/initiative/defensive reaction/damage/injury procedures remain primary; original Jurassic pounce +1 attack die earned once after physically legal approach in combat round one; base damage unchanged.
additions: Only real co-located exposed actors are eligible for raptor attacks. A concealed actor carrying a lit lamp can be exposed and targeted; unlit cover remains effective pending legitimate active search.
First encounter strike after physically legal single-edge stalk/investigation movement can use original pounce (+1 attack die), no extra attack slot, no bonus damage or mandatory hit.
No pounce from blocked, nonadjacent, stationary, stale, prior-round or already-used approach history; shut reinforced utility/shed door prevents false pounces.
Defender is informed before rolling, using pre-existing Close Combat choice; source-consistent surprise bonus remains separate.
Recorded committed attack includes tactic and exact attackDice, and all existing seeded RNG, health, armor and trauma procedures continue.
Party, Character and Spectator modes and older party v3 saves retain deterministic state and individual perspective.

Closed shutter blocks two-way legal movement for survivors and Velociraptor, interrupts visual link, attenuates sound and cancels otherwise invalid pounce opening.

No additional persistent ecology, island weather engine, spontaneous creature encounters or AI adjudication.

scene_director_implementation.status: 008-A accepted on main f8b4e42bdb2c7302f3dd2e6e1f9a03520b5f7d21 with 377/377; 008-B1 adds a bounded original physical danger using the same Evolved engine.
behavior: Seven authored room-conditional scene events offer optional player actions, validated for real actor, local room, event prerequisites, active status and one-time per-character history.
Event selections add an actor-owned log without consuming time/dice or changing creatures, inventory, stress or scenario objectives; existing personalized Wonder journal remains independent.
Accepted outdoor exploration actions check a bounded actor-local d6 pressure clock. On a face of one, pressure advances; sneaking reduces the check pool and rushing increases it.
Pressure never forces encounters or spawns animals. At most, an actor-only heavy-movement sound cue can appear at threshold if a real, physically audible Velociraptor is nearby.
Camera/controller switches preserve event and pressure state. Old v3 party saves missing optional fields remain valid; invalid entries reject.
Distant herbivore scene is unavailable during the authored sight-obscuring squall; it becomes selectable when the storm clears.
